diffusion._source: ResShift's 15-step config (configs/realsr_swinunet_realesrgan256.yaml). The paper's text says eta_T = 0.999; the code uses sqrt(eta_T) = 0.99. mask_loss_weight 1 = ResShift's plain loss.

model._inputs: x_t (1) + cond: damaged print, mask, cos 2theta, sin 2theta (4)

training.data: FixedTrainDataset (preprocessing/data/train/damaged/), v2 damage: 6 contaminants, severity 0-0.8; + minutiae maps (preprocessing/data/train/minutiae_w/, script 09)

aux._note: aux_losses maps each term (fpr.training.aux_losses.TERMS) to lam, or to {lam, <arguments>}; lam is calibrated with train.py --calibrate 20 to ~20% of L_diff at init. The terms act inside the damage mask grown by dilate_px, at steps with eta_t <= eta_max (t = 1..11); minutiae weight w = 1 + lam_m * w_norm.
